timing_scope: Real-clock phases; API duration includes network, provider queue and model time. Residual includes local compute, polling, unresolved API intervals and harness overhead; not individually identifiable. Identical bodies are reported without assuming retries or loops. retry_scope: All intercepted outgoing calls counted. Native operation retries where persisted are separately audited; repeated input fingerprints and multi-turn tool calls are not automatically retries. No visible HTTP failures; unlogged upstream internal retries remain unknown.
